title: Promotion Record
description: The audit trail of one /promote-to-vault attempt (the M⇒D seam, write side). Output of the human promotion gate via promote.py. result-status + can-cite-thesis are RE-DERIVED by promote.rederive() from the ACTUAL referenced audit artifacts (leakage / fairness / reviewer) plus the human freeze flag — never copied from any payload's self-claim (blueprint §0: 'the promoter re-derives status and never trusts a sidecar's self-claim'). The allOf enforces the safety direction: admissible can be true ONLY when rederived_result_status == 'frozen' AND rederived_can_cite_thesis == true AND a vault_path was written. provisional / non-frozen ⇒ admissible must be false (structurally non-promotable). Mirrors the derivation family of venue_readiness_verdict.schema.json + sanity_verdict.schema.json.

candidate_ref.description: Reference (path + sha) to the promotion_candidate this record decides. Same {path, sha256} shape as ledger artifact refs.

admissible.description: Whether the candidate was admitted into System D. true ONLY when re-derived frozen + citable (see allOf). false ⇒ rejected, vault untouched.

rederived_result_status.description: RE-DERIVED result-status (05-registry/status-registry.md). 'frozen' iff human_freeze AND reviewer≠BLOCK AND leakage==pass AND fairness==pass AND source not invalid/superseded; else passes through the source non-frozen status or 'provisional'. Never copied from a self-claim.

rederived_can_cite_thesis.description: RE-DERIVED: (rederived_result_status=='frozen') AND leakage==pass AND fairness==pass. Manual override forbidden (status-registry derived-field rule). Never copied from a self-claim.

reasons.description: Non-empty derivation trace: every fact that drove admit/reject (e.g. 'leakage-audit=fail', 'no human_freeze', 'reviewer=BLOCK', 'admitted: frozen+leakage_pass+fairness_pass').

vault_path.description: Where the page was written in System D (02-wiki/<type>/<slug>.md) when admitted; null when rejected.

vault_slug.description: The lowercase-kebab slug written (admitted), else null.

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the promotion decision.
